en: A black-and-white photographic postcard featuring a panoramic view of an imposing industrial or institutional building complex, likely from the early 20th century. The architecture is characterized by symmetry, large windows, and mansard-style roofs. In the foreground are a few standalone houses, trees, and a fenced area, with open countryside visible in the background. The code 'B.N. 1848' and possibly additional text are handwritten along the bottom edge.
